summary:
The 'Astralunar' project aims to recover and highlight the history of space probes and equipment sent on previous missions, which are now abandoned in space. To achieve this, an educational game was developed in Python using the Pygame library, featuring five stages connected by an original storyline. Throughout the experience, players learn about the history of these technologies, their purposes, and their main contributions to space exploration.

The initiative addresses the challenge by recovering and sharing information about this equipment, emphasizing its historical and scientific relevance even after its missions have come to an end. By combining entertainment and education, the project seeks to transform learning into an active experience, sparking curiosity and encouraging the pursuit of new knowledge. Its importance lies in bringing younger generations closer to the history of space exploration and demonstrating how technologies once considered outdated were essential to the scientific and technological advances that are now part of our everyday lives.
details:
Our project consists of an educational and interactive game that presents the history of space probes and equipment sent into space since the Apollo 11 mission, highlighting their purposes, how they work, and their contributions to scientific and technological development.

The game is structured into five stages, connected by an original storyline in which players learn about these technologies as they progress through different challenges. The proposal aims to transform learning into an active and engaging experience, sparking curiosity and encouraging players to seek further knowledge about space exploration.

Python and its Pygame library were used in the development process, handling the game's programming and construction. NotebookLM was used to research and organize information, relying exclusively on sources provided by NASA. In addition, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude were used as artificial intelligence tools to assist in developing, organizing, and improving the project's content and ideas.

The project's creative strength lies in combining storytelling, interactivity, and science communication. By transforming historical information into an engaging gaming experience, we aim to bring younger generations closer to the history of space exploration and demonstrate how technologies from past missions have contributed to the advances we know today.
